test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

A 2007 - 2009 study

P. explored forward thinking techniques

Q. to synchronise time on board deep

R. space probes for accurate navigation, in 

S. particular looking into low-cost options.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e. "PQRS." 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the abovementioned paragraph, there is a chronological sequence of the sentences.
 
• Sentence P is the first sentence as the sentence begins with the noun 'A 2007 - 2009 study' and therefore it will be followed by a verb. Among the given options the verb is '**explored**.' It mentions a 2007–2009 study investigated methods for thinking ahead.
 
• Sentence Q is the second sentence as it begins with the direct infinitive **'to synchronise' **and describes the purpose of the forward thinking techniques. Thus it establishes a relation with the previous sentence.
 
• The only option that shows such an arrangement is Option 4.
 
• Sentence R is the third sentence as it begins with the noun 'space probes' and it shows a relation with the previous sentence which ended with the adjective 'deep.' It mentions the purpose of deep space probes.
 
• Sentence S is the last sentence and it mentions the study was focused on low-cost methods for synchronising time on deep space probes for precise navigation.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

The correct order is:__ 

A 2007 - 2009 study

P. explored forward thinking techniques

Q. to synchronise time on board deep

R. space probes for accurate navigation, in 

S. particular looking into low-cost options.
